name: Tabit
description: A naked-eye star 8.1 parsecs away, 1.3 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 30652: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.526 +/- 0.004 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.323 +/- 0.004

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 30652: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.283 +/- 0.006

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 30652: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6516 +/- 19

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3288921720025503360 (quality A), from 2020AJ....160...83S; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 30652: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 123.94 +/- 0.17 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 8 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.3 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.526 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.323 solar radii and 6,516 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 30652: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
